fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Your passport must have an expiry date at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave New Zealand.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe vencer al menos 3 meses después del día en que planeas salir de Nueva Zelanda.
entry.quote: To enter New Zealand, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave.

entry.en: You can visit New Zealand without a visa for up to 6 months, but you do need a New Zealand Electronic Travel Authority (NZeTA).
entry.es: Se puede visitar Nueva Zelanda sin visa hasta 6 meses, pero se necesita una autorización electrónica de viaje (NZeTA).
entry.quote: You can visit New Zealand without a visa for up to 6 months. However you do need a New Zealand Electronic Travel Authority (NZeTA).

entry.en: Wikivoyage gives the total cost of the NZeTA including the IVL levy as $117 via app or $123 via website.
entry.es: Wikivoyage indica que el costo total de la NZeTA con la tasa IVL es de $117 por app o $123 por la web.
entry.quote: The total cost of the NZeTA including the IVL is $117 (via app) or $123 (via website).

entry.en: Everyone entering New Zealand must complete a free New Zealand Traveller Declaration, online or via the NZTD app.
entry.es: Todos los que entran a Nueva Zelanda deben completar una Declaración del Viajero gratuita, en línea o con la app NZTD.
entry.quote: Everyone travelling into New Zealand needs to complete a New Zealand Traveller Declaration (NZTD). It is free and you can use the online form or the NZTD app.

entry.en: Wikivoyage says visitors must have a return ticket or evidence of onward travel to check in with airlines.
entry.es: Wikivoyage dice que los visitantes deben tener un billete de vuelta o prueba de viaje de continuación para facturar.
entry.quote: you must have a return ticket or evidence of onward travel to even check-in with airlines.

entry.en: It is illegal to import most food products, and you must declare anything that may be prohibited or subject to tax or duty.
entry.es: Es ilegal importar la mayoría de alimentos y debes declarar todo lo que pueda estar prohibido o sujeto a impuestos o aranceles.
entry.quote: It is illegal to import most food products. You must declare anything that may be prohibited or subject to tax or duty.

safety.en: Crime levels are generally low, but street crime happens in major towns and cities, and thieves may target unattended hire cars and camper vans.
safety.es: La criminalidad es generalmente baja, pero hay delitos callejeros en ciudades grandes y los ladrones pueden apuntar a coches de alquiler y autocaravanas sin vigilar.
safety.quote: Crime levels are generally low, but street crime happens in major towns and cities. Thieves may target unattended vehicles, especially hire cars and camper vans in major tourist areas.

safety.en: New Zealand is in a major earthquake zone and tsunamis can happen along the coastlines.
safety.es: Nueva Zelanda está en una importante zona sísmica y pueden ocurrir tsunamis en las costas.
safety.quote: New Zealand is in a major earthquake zone. Tsunamis can happen along the coastlines.

safety.en: Weather conditions can quickly become dangerous in some coastal and exposed areas.
safety.es: Las condiciones del tiempo pueden volverse peligrosas rápidamente en algunas zonas costeras y expuestas.
safety.quote: Weather conditions can quickly become dangerous in some coastal and exposed areas.

safety.en: There are several active volcanoes on the North Island.
safety.es: Hay varios volcanes activos en la Isla Norte.
safety.quote: There are several active volcanoes on the North Island of New Zealand.

safety.en: Highways can be narrow, winding and hilly.
safety.es: Las carreteras pueden ser estrechas, sinuosas y con cuestas.
safety.quote: Highways can be narrow, winding and hilly.

safety.en: British nationals have been involved in tragic accidents while doing extreme sports.
safety.es: Ciudadanos británicos han sufrido accidentes trágicos practicando deportes extremos.
safety.quote: British nationals have been involved in tragic accidents while doing extreme sports activities.

health.en: British nationals living in the UK on a short-term visit are eligible for urgent healthcare treatment.
health.es: Los británicos residentes en el Reino Unido en visita corta tienen derecho a atención médica urgente.
health.quote: British nationals who live in the UK and who are on a short-term visit to New Zealand are eligible for urgent healthcare treatment.

health.en: You can call Healthline for free medical advice, 24 hours a day.
health.es: Puedes llamar a Healthline para recibir asesoría médica gratuita las 24 horas.
health.quote: You can call Healthline for free medical advice (24 hours).

health.en: Wikivoyage says funding for illnesses is not available for visitors, for whom travel insurance is highly recommended.
health.es: Wikivoyage dice que los visitantes no reciben financiación para enfermedades, por lo que se recomienda mucho un seguro de viaje.
health.quote: Funding for illnesses is not available for short term workers; international students; and visitors, for which travel insurance is highly recommended.

health.en: Wikivoyage says tap water is regarded as some of the cleanest in the world and is safe to drink in all cities.
health.es: Wikivoyage dice que el agua del grifo se considera de las más limpias del mundo y es segura para beber en todas las ciudades.
health.quote: Tap water in New Zealand is regarded as some of the cleanest in the world; it is safe to drink in all cities.

health.en: Wikivoyage advises not to drink water from rural streams without boiling it first, because of Giardia.
health.es: Wikivoyage aconseja no beber agua de arroyos rurales sin hervirla antes, por la Giardia.
health.quote: Precautions should be taken against Giardia when tramping: do not drink water from rural streams without boiling it first.

health.en: Wikivoyage says ultraviolet radiation is around 40% more intense than in the Mediterranean in summer.
health.es: Wikivoyage dice que la radiación ultravioleta es cerca de un 40% más intensa que en el Mediterráneo en verano.
health.quote: New Zealand has very high levels of ultraviolet radiation, around 40% more intense than you will find in the Mediterranean during summer

help.en: The emergency number for ambulance, fire and police is 111.
help.es: El número de emergencias para ambulancia, bomberos y policía es el 111.

help.en: Wikivoyage says you can call 105 for non-emergency police matters, such as reporting a theft or burglary.
help.es: Wikivoyage dice que puedes llamar al 105 para asuntos policiales no urgentes, como denunciar un robo.
help.quote: You can call 105 for non-emergency police, e.g. to report a theft or burglary

help.en: FCDO in London can be called 24 hours on 020 7008 5000 if something has happened to a friend or relative abroad.
help.es: El FCDO en Londres atiende las 24 horas al 020 7008 5000 si algo le ha pasado a un amigo o familiar en el extranjero.

getting_in.en: Auckland (AKL) is the primary entry point and the main hub of Air New Zealand.
getting_in.es: Auckland (AKL) es el principal punto de entrada y el centro principal de Air New Zealand.
getting_in.quote: Auckland (AKL IATA) is the primary entry point and the main hub for flag carrier Air New Zealand.

getting_in.en: Christchurch International Airport (CHC) is the main secondary entry point.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto internacional de Christchurch (CHC) es el principal punto de entrada secundario.
getting_in.quote: Christchurch International Airport (CHC IATA) is the main secondary entry point

getting_in.en: Wellington (WLG) and Queenstown (ZQN) are smaller international airports serving mainly eastern Australia.
getting_in.es: Wellington (WLG) y Queenstown (ZQN) son aeropuertos internacionales menores que atienden sobre todo el este de Australia.
getting_in.quote: Smaller international airports at Wellington (WLG IATA) and Queenstown (ZQN IATA) primarily offer services to and from eastern Australia.

getting_in.en: Flights take 3–4 hours from the Australian east coast, 10–11 from Southeast Asia and 13–15 from the North American west coast.
getting_in.es: Los vuelos duran 3–4 horas desde la costa este de Australia, 10–11 desde el sudeste asiático y 13–15 desde la costa oeste de Norteamérica.
getting_in.quote: Flight time from the Australian east coast is 3–4 hours, Southeast Asia 10–11 hours, the North American west coast 13–15 hours

getting_in.en: Arriving passengers connecting to a domestic flight must collect checked baggage, clear customs and quarantine, and re-drop the baggage.
getting_in.es: Los pasajeros que conectan con un vuelo doméstico deben recoger el equipaje, pasar aduana y cuarentena, y volver a entregarlo.
getting_in.quote: If you are arriving in New Zealand and connecting to a domestic flight, you will need to collect your checked baggage, pass through customs and quarantine, and then re-drop your baggage

getting_in.en: Cruise ships regularly visit New Zealand between October and April.
getting_in.es: Los cruceros visitan Nueva Zelanda con regularidad entre octubre y abril.
getting_in.quote: Cruise ships regularly visit New Zealand between October and April.

getting_around.en: Public transport is usable in Auckland and Wellington, but elsewhere a car is almost essential.
getting_around.es: El transporte público es utilizable en Auckland y Wellington, pero en otros lugares un coche es casi imprescindible.
getting_around.quote: While public transport is usable in the cities of Auckland and Wellington, a car is almost essential to get around anywhere else

getting_around.en: Traffic drives on the left in New Zealand.
getting_around.es: En Nueva Zelanda se conduce por la izquierda.
getting_around.quote: Traffic drives on the left in New Zealand.

getting_around.en: You can legally drive for up to 12 months with a current full licence from your home country if you are at least 18.
getting_around.es: Puedes conducir legalmente hasta 12 meses con una licencia completa vigente de tu país si tienes al menos 18 años.
getting_around.quote: You can legally drive for up to 12 months if you are at least 18 years old and have a current full driving licence from your home country.

getting_around.en: Speed limits are generally 50 km/h in urban areas and 100 km/h in rural areas and on motorways.
getting_around.es: Los límites de velocidad suelen ser 50 km/h en zonas urbanas y 100 km/h en zonas rurales y autopistas.
getting_around.quote: Speed limits are generally 50 km/h in urban areas, and 100 km/h in rural areas and on motorways.

getting_around.en: Coaches are relatively cheap, with services usually only once a day even between major towns.
getting_around.es: Los autocares son relativamente baratos, con servicios normalmente una vez al día incluso entre ciudades importantes.
getting_around.quote: Coaches (long-distance buses) are a relatively cheap and environmentally friendly way to get around New Zealand. Services are usually only once a day, even between major towns.

getting_around.en: Domestic flights can be expensive, but often work out cheaper than driving or taking a train, especially between the two main islands.
getting_around.es: Los vuelos internos pueden ser caros, pero a menudo salen más baratos que conducir o ir en tren, sobre todo entre las dos islas.
getting_around.quote: Domestic flights in New Zealand can be expensive; some domestic flights can cost as much as a flight to Australia. However, flying often works out cheaper than driving or taking a train, especially when crossing between the North and South Islands.

money.en: The currency is the New Zealand dollar (NZD), divided into 100 cents.
money.es: La moneda es el dólar neozelandés (NZD), dividido en 100 centavos.
money.quote: The currency used in New Zealand is the New Zealand dollar, denoted by the symbol "$" or "NZ$" (ISO code: NZD).

money.en: Nearly all shops have Eftpos terminals for debit and credit cards, so most purchases can be made electronically.
money.es: Casi todas las tiendas tienen terminales Eftpos para tarjetas, por lo que la mayoría de compras pueden hacerse electrónicamente.
money.quote: Nearly all shops have Eftpos terminals for debit and credit cards, so most purchases can be made electronically.

money.en: Tourists should still carry cash because some stores do not accept foreign cards.
money.es: Los turistas deben llevar efectivo, pues algunas tiendas no aceptan tarjetas extranjeras.
money.quote: As a tourist, you should still carry cash as there will be stores that don't accept foreign cards.

money.en: Tipping is not part of New Zealand culture and is often treated with suspicion or frowned upon.
money.es: La propina no es parte de la cultura neozelandesa y a menudo se mira con recelo o se desaprueba.
money.quote: Tipping is not part of New Zealand culture and is often treated with suspicion or actively frowned upon

money.en: Goods and services are subject to 15% GST, which is usually included in the advertised price.
money.es: Los bienes y servicios llevan un 15% de GST, que normalmente está incluido en el precio anunciado.
money.quote: Goods and services sold in New Zealand are subject to 15% Goods and Services Tax (GST). The tax is usually included in the advertised price

money.en: Ordinary visitors cannot claim a refund on GST already paid when leaving the country.
money.es: Los visitantes comunes no pueden reclamar el reembolso del GST pagado al salir del país.
money.quote: Ordinary visitors cannot claim a refund on GST already paid when leaving the country.

etiquette.en: New Zealanders are generally warm and sociable, but will hold strangers at a distance.
etiquette.es: Los neozelandeses suelen ser cálidos y sociables, pero mantienen a los desconocidos a distancia.
etiquette.quote: New Zealanders are generally warm and sociable, but will hold strangers at a distance.

etiquette.en: When visiting someone's house, it is considered polite to bring a gift.
etiquette.es: Al visitar una casa, se considera cortés llevar un regalo.
etiquette.quote: If you are visiting someone's house, it is considered polite to bring a gift.

etiquette.en: Politics can be a touchy subject, so avoid it until you feel comfortable with the people you are speaking to.
etiquette.es: La política puede ser un tema delicado; evítala hasta sentirte cómodo con tus interlocutores.
etiquette.quote: Avoid bringing up politics until you feel comfortable with the people you are speaking to.

etiquette.en: New Zealanders generally dress smart casual, often in black or dark clothing.
etiquette.es: Los neozelandeses suelen vestir casual elegante, a menudo de negro o colores oscuros.
etiquette.quote: New Zealanders generally dress 'smart casual', with a prevalence of wearing black or dark clothing.

etiquette.en: Do not eat, drink or wear shoes inside a wharenui, the Māori carved meeting house.
etiquette.es: No comas, bebas ni uses zapatos dentro de un wharenui, la casa de reuniones tallada maorí.
etiquette.quote: Do not eat, drink or wear shoes inside the wharenui (carved meeting house).

etiquette.en: A person's head is considered tapu (sacred) in Māori custom, so do not touch it without permission.
etiquette.es: En la costumbre maorí la cabeza de una persona es tapu (sagrada), así que no la toques sin permiso.
etiquette.quote: A person's head is considered tapu (sacred). Do not touch someone's head without permission, pass anything over anyone's head, or sit on a pillow

connectivity.en: SIM cards are widely available and no registration is necessary.
connectivity.es: Las tarjetas SIM son fáciles de conseguir y no requieren registro.
connectivity.quote: SIM cards are widely available and no registration is necessary.

connectivity.en: The three major mobile operators are Spark, One NZ and 2degrees.
connectivity.es: Los tres grandes operadores móviles son Spark, One NZ y 2degrees.
connectivity.quote: The three major mobile network operators are Spark, One NZ (formerly Vodafone NZ), and 2degrees.

connectivity.en: All networks provide 4G and 5G only, as 2G and 3G service will shut down by the end of March 2026.
connectivity.es: Todas las redes ofrecen solo 4G y 5G, ya que el servicio 2G y 3G se apagará a fines de marzo de 2026.
connectivity.quote: All networks provide 4G and 5G service only; 2G and 3G service will shut down by the end of March 2026.

connectivity.en: Do not rely on mobile phones in hilly or mountainous terrain.
connectivity.es: No confíes en el teléfono móvil en terreno montañoso o con colinas.
connectivity.quote: Do not rely on mobile phones in hilly or mountainous terrain.

connectivity.en: Free Wi-Fi is widely available in urban areas, such as cafés, restaurants, shopping centres and fast food outlets.
connectivity.es: El wifi gratuito abunda en zonas urbanas, como cafés, restaurantes, centros comerciales y locales de comida rápida.
connectivity.quote: Free Wi-Fi is widely available in urban areas, especially in cafés, restaurants, shopping centres, fast food outlets
